sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned HCGP for respondent No.1.
Respondent No.2, who is served in the matter has remained unrepresented before this Court.

NC: 2024:KHC:51200 3. FIR in Crime No.222/2024 was registered by Shivamogga Rural Police Station, Shivamogga,
against the petitioner herein initially for the offences under Sections 87, 64(2)(m), 352, 351(2) of BNS, 2023 and Section 6 of the POCSO, on the basis of the first information dated 09.08.2024 received from the victim girl aged about 17 years.

During the course of investigation of the case,
petitioner herein was arrested on 10.08.2024 and subsequently remanded to judicial custody.
Investigation of the case is complete and charge sheet has been filed against him for the aforesaid offences.
The bail application filed by the petitioner before the Trial Court in Spl.Case No.342/2024 was rejected on 23.10.2024.
Therefore, he is before this Court.

sentences.text: A false case has been filed against the petitioner making baseless allegation.
The medical records of the victim girl does not NC: 2024:KHC:51200 support the charge sheet allegations.
The petitioner who has no criminal antecedents is in custody for last 4 months.
Hence, he prays to allow the petition.
5. Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the bail application.
He submits that the victim girl is a minor and she has made allegation against the petitioner in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.PC.
Accordingly, he prays to dismiss the petition.

6. First information was received from the victim girl aged 17 years on 09.08.2024, based on which,
FIR in Crime No.222/2024 was registered by the Shivamogga Rural Police Station against the petitioner.
During the course of investigation, the petitioner was arrested and he is in custody since 10.08.2024.
Investigation in the case is complete and charge sheet has been filed.

During the course of investigation, statement of the victim girl under Section 164 of Cr.PC was recorded on 17.08.2024.
7.

The victim girl in her statement has stated that when she was studying in 2nd PUC, she came to know NC: 2024:KHC:51200 Dasthagir-petitioner about 2 months prior to the first information and he had informed her that he was liking and loving her but she had only friendship with him.
On 13.07.2024, the petitioner had taken her to Durga lodge near Machenahally, and had sexual intercourse with her against her wishes and took some private photos on the very same day.

Again on 22.07.2024 and 27.07.2024, the petitioner had threatened her that he will be circulating the private photos to his friends and relatives and had taken her to said Durga lodge and had sexual intercourse forcibly.
On 09.08.2024 also he had called her to accompany him, when she refused, the petitioner had criminally intimidated her to commit suicide and thereby she had attempted to commit suicide.
Thereafter, her family members came to know about the act committed by the petitioner and she had approached the Police and submitted first information.
8. The Doctor, who has medically examined the victim girl on 10.08.2024, has opined that there was no NC: 2024:KHC:51200 signs suggestive of recent sexual intercourse.
In the medical records, it is also mentioned that there were no signs suggestive of struggle.
The petitioner is aged about 23 years having no criminal antecedents and he is in custody for the last more than 4 months.
Investigation of the case is complete and charge sheet has been filed.

His continued detention in the custody is likely to have adverse impact on his future prospects and allegation now made as against the petitioner in the charge sheet is required to be proved in the full-pledged trial.
Under such circumstances, I am of the opinion that the prayer made by the petitioner for grant of regular bail is required to be answered affirmatively.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER
The petition is allowed.

The petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail in Crime No.222/2024 registered by Shivamogga Rural Police Station registered for the offences punishable under Sections 366, 376(2)(n) of IPC, Sections 87, 64(2)(m),
352, 351(2) of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023 and Section 6 of the Protection of NC: 2024:KHC:51200 Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, subject to the following conditions:
